notes.title: Update 2.1.3
notes.content:
Now you can play with the cast of Wild Romance in a totally new way. Set the scene, create the text and formulate their fresh dialogue however you please. 

Giving you the freedom to put whatever you want in your favorite furry friends mouth.

Bringing new life to the original Cherry Kiss title, we have now updated Wild Romance with our new premium polish.

notes.title: Wild Romance Remastered - 5 Year Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33669860/cea2f3c3255433c41064443aa2257524fad385d1.png[/img]

We’ve revamped and remastered the original Wild Romance for your viewing pleasure! This is a FREE upgrade for anyone that has already purchased the game!

This is the 5 Year Anniversary of Wild Romance to the day! We've added these new features that would satisfy any visual novel veteran:

[list]
[*] Complete overhaul in new engine
[*] Animated sprites
[*] More than one character on screen at once
[*] Toggleable character portraits in the text box
[*] Multilingual support within single executable 
[*] Upscaled high resolution graphics
[*] Rollback functionality
[*] Steam Achievements 
[*] English Japanese & now also including [b]Spanish[/b] 
[*] Now also available on MAC & LINUX
[/list]

A heartwarming traditional Japanese style visual novel has been revitalized for a new generation of readers. Enjoy the classic tale of Kazuma’s homecoming after an unfulfilling stint of life in Tokyo.

[b]Please note that this version of Wild Romance does not include any explicit sexual content.[/b]
